title: One live archetype-registry reader: grid cache and fairness gate follow edits
deviations_from_card: (1) Invalidation: writeRegistry bumps a write-generation counter (registryWriteGeneration) that the live reader folds into its memo key, instead of calling invalidateLiveRegistry() - archetype-live imports parseRegistryDocument from archetype-registry, so the reverse import would be a cycle; invalidateLiveRegistry() is still exported. (2) Path override is a test-only setter (setLiveRegistryPathForTest), not an env var, so production can never read a different file than Python. (3) Case 3 is pinned over every bundled id + ids unknown to both (live >= bundle); for a live-only id the bundled 'unknown -> shielded' default is replaced by that id's own live entry - that is what cases 1/7/8 require (ops_lead unprotected is auto-reject eligible, as it already is in Python). An unreadable file keeps live-only ids shielded. (4) Per the critic, the shield rule is shieldsFromAutoReject = fairnessProtected OR scoringModel early_career (Python keys on scoringModel), shared by the bundled gate and the live reader; bundled results unchanged for today's registry. Added case 2b (stat memo alone picks up a rewrite) and 2c (scoringModel key). (5) Added the one coupled doc allowance: docs/features/matching/README.md (matrix-cache paragraph named the key axes). (6) automation-fairness.test.ts's module hook now treats only real code extensions as extensions (the live reader's graph reaches taxonomy.generated).
notes: Readers named: the only server fairness DECIDERS are screen-wave.ts and automation-fairness.ts (both now live; screen-wave takes one snapshot per wave so the eligibility pass, the decision loop and the approval token see one file). The only registry-keyed CACHE on the scoring path touched is /api/matrix (digest axis + re-check of the digest after the spawn before caching - the lock-or-re-check law). app/api/matrix/route.ts engineRefusal/ENGINE_BUSY catch from llm-inference-runtime/B kept intact. loop_open: (a) app/_lib/cache-key.ts / analyze-run.ts - the analyze cache key still omits the registry digest (card's runner-up, deferred because r07 cards rewrite analyze-run.ts); (b) isEarlyCareer server callers (comms-dispatch.ts rejection copy, group-eval-run.ts, interview-run.ts, interview-agenda.ts, interview-prep-*.ts, interview-planned-minutes.ts, interview-rubric.ts, api/interview/compare/route.ts) still classify early-career from the bundle - copy/plan selection, not the auto-reject shield, but a live-registered early_career custom archetype gets the experienced plan/copy until rebuild; rule to apply: swap to readLiveArchetypes() with an isEarlyCareer on the snapshot. Gates: tsc red ONLY on foreign paths (app/_components/voice/* sibling in-flight, untracked kpi-sim/ copy tree); full test:unit had 2 foreign failures (drawerCommsTruth.test.ts BROKEN on sibling's uncommitted comms-dispatch.ts; python-runner-concurrency FLAKE, sibling's python-runner.ts) - all my touched-dir tests green (119 + new). test:perf on the shared checkout red only on hire-from-need (3185 vs 3183 KB) from sibling uncommitted files; measured base 8d7bb1ea7 + my files alone via git archive: findings [] (hire-from-need 3176.1 -> 3177.6 KB, matrix 40/753 -> 46/805, screen-wave route 108/1700 -> 112/1739, page.tsx 9083.9 -> 9085.3 KB, no module change) - no ceiling raised.
